class: Classified employer emails recorded in a shape the tracker always discards, and no inbox to read them
fix: diagnostics.EVENT_KINDS allows employer_email and EVENT_ENUMS['signal'] allows the eight signal words; record_employer_signal persists payload {'signal': kind} (free text still cannot pass, by design); detail History reads the signal word; both trackers gain recent_employer_signals (Postgres mirrors SQLite, server-unverified here); the dashboard lists the newest ten with links. The f321 recording test's message-shape assertion (a shape no real tracker keeps) now pins the payload contract.
prevention: New event kinds arrive with allowlist entries and a round-trip test through a real tracker, not a fake.
root_cause: f321 recorded the signal in the event message, which both trackers unconditionally replace, under a kind the allowlist rewrote to 'other' -- and its recording test used a fake tracker that kept both, so the suite stayed green while production kept nothing.
site: Employer-email pipeline, diagnostics.py + employer_signals.py + job_tracker.py + db.py + detail_view.py + web_ui.py, 3 November 2026
symptom: No employer reply ever reached the tracker: interview invites and rejections were classified, then stored as kind 'other' with the signal text discarded, and the dashboard had no inbox.
why_tests_missed: The f321 recording test asserted the call shape against a fake tracker instead of round-tripping through a real one, so the sanitizer's rewrite stayed invisible.
